author: reek
body: nic-ping covers the neighbouring ground and cannot cover this: it drives the NE2000 data port a byte at a time with port-in-byte, so it never issues a string operation and never reaches net-recv-raw. That left the driver's own receive path -- ne2k-recv-frame, net-recv-raw, and the REP INSW the emitter writes for it -- exercised by no test in the battery, which is how a change to the host's handling of that instruction came to be made against no coverage at all.

author: reek
body: This sends one ARP request through ne2k-send-frame and drains the reply through ne2k-recv-frame. codex-vm's NAT answers ARP for the gateway, the same reply nic-ping already depends on.
